originShared.text: None of these states is one of the states CSLB reciprocates with (Arizona, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nevada, and North Carolina), so no reciprocity applies.
CSLB's NASCLA reciprocity route is for applicants for the General Building classification, so it does not cover C-20.
Apply with CSLB's Application for Original Contractor License and the $450 non-refundable application fee.

Document at least four years of journeyman-level or higher C-20 experience, obtained within the last 10 years, on CSLB's Certification of Work Experience form. The form's definition of a contractor includes an out-of-state licensed contractor.
After CSLB accepts the application, pass a trade exam and/or a business and law exam; exam fees are paid directly to the testing vendor.
